Designed for all-day comfort, the Ace2 Ergonomic High Back Chair combines breathable mesh support with extensive ergonomic adjustments to help you stay comfortable and focused throughout the working day.

Its adaptive lumbar support, adjustable headrest, armrests and seat depth allow the chair to better accommodate different body types and sitting preferences. A multi-position reclining mechanism provides additional flexibility when switching between focused work and relaxed sitting.

  • Premium breathable mesh back and seat
  • 3D adjustable headrest
  • 3D adjustable armrests
  • Adjustable lumbar support
  • Adjustable backrest height
  • Seat slider with up to 8 cm depth adjustment
  • 4 lockable recline positions
  • Weight-sensitive reclining mechanism
  • Class 4 gas lift
  • Heavy-duty nylon base
  • 50 mm silent castors
  • Weight capacity: Up to 150 kg
  • Recommended user height: 150–185 cm
  • Colour: Black

Enhance your meeting space with this modern boat-shape conference table, designed for corporate offices across Kuala Lumpur, Bukit Jalil, Klang, Shah Alam, and Puchong. name: Ace Meet - Office Pod | Office Phone Booth - For 2 - 4 Seater (Kindly contact us before order)
category: Office Phone Booth & Soundproof Pods Malaysia | ACE Pods
desc: 4–6 Seater Acoustic Meeting Pod | Office Sharing Booth KL Ace Hub: A Private Meeting Space for Larger Teams Ace Hub is a spacious office pod and acoustic office booth designed for private meetings, presentations and collaborative working sessions inv
descHtml:
Ace Meet: Private Meeting Space Without Renovation

Ace Meet is a 2–4 person office pod and acoustic office booth designed for private discussions, hybrid meetings and small-team collaboration.

With tested acoustic performance of approximately 27 dBA, Ace Meet helps reduce surrounding office noise and improves conversation privacy. Teams can communicate, share ideas and conduct meetings with fewer distractions from the surrounding workplace.

Integrated seating, a central table, built-in lighting, low-noise ventilation and convenient power access create a comfortable and practical meeting space that is ready for daily use.

Ace Meet provides a flexible alternative to constructing a permanent meeting room. This acoustic office booth can be installed with minimal disruption and relocated when your office requirements or layout change.

Suitable for:

• Small-team meetings
• Private discussions
• Hybrid and video meetings
• Client consultations
• Interviews and presentations
• Collaborative working sessions

External size: 2200W x 1200D mm 

Internal size: 2030W x 1140D mm

Internal Height: 2117h mm

External Height: 2250h mm

Recommended minimum room height: 2500 mm
Tested acoustic performance: Approximately 27 dBA noise reduction

Please contact our team before ordering to confirm your preferred colours, interior configuration, power requirements, delivery location and installation access.

Exterior colour: ORANGE SQUASH, MUSTARD YELLOW, GREEN MOSS, OCEAN BLUE, GREY ASH, CHARCOAL GREY

Interior Colour: Wood based Melamine - Shimo Ash

**Item price not inclusive of delivery and handling charges (differs on location and if only staircase are available)

Handling charges: Handle item up physical staircase, handle per staircase level: +RM400

if handle by lift; handling charges is free

Note that the prices listed on our website do not currently include handling, installation, and delivery charges. These costs can vary depending on the delivery location and the manpower required for handling the weight of the booth.

Klang Valley Charges only (other areas will have different charges) :

Installation: RM650 per unit (within Klang Valley only) . Other areas have different charges

Delivery: Free Delivery within Klang Valley

Kindly contact us at 011-54209676 (Nicholas) before ordering

Lead time to delivery : Within 3-4 working weeks after order and payment confirmation

descHtml:
Luna Designer Chair

The Luna Designer Chair is a modern minimalist seating solution designed for contemporary commercial and residential interiors throughout Malaysia.

Manufactured using durable PP Virgin material, this chair combines sleek aesthetics with reliable strength and everyday comfort. Its curved ergonomic backrest and clean flowing silhouette create a stylish appearance suitable for cafés, restaurants, dining spaces, office pantries, discussion areas, meeting spaces, and modern home interiors.

Lightweight yet durable, the Luna Chair offers comfortable seating while maintaining a clean Scandinavian-inspired design suitable for modern environments.

Its compact footprint allows easy arrangement in cafés, dining areas, waiting spaces, and collaborative office environments.

Key Features

  • Modern minimalist designer appearance
  • Durable PP Virgin construction
  • Ergonomic curved backrest
  • Lightweight and easy to move
  • Smooth seamless finishing
  • Suitable for commercial and residential use
  • Easy cleaning and maintenance
  • Contemporary Scandinavian-inspired design

desc: PRE ORDER UNIT: MINIMUM ORDER OF 10 UNITS & ABOVE! ALTO High Back Office Chair Product Description The ALTO High Back Office Chair is designed to provide dependable comfort and supportive seating for everyday office use. Its high backrest and adjusta
descHtml:
PRE ORDER UNIT: MINIMUM ORDER OF 10 UNITS & ABOVE!

ALTO High Back Office Chair

Product Description

The ALTO High Back Office Chair is designed to provide dependable comfort and supportive seating for everyday office use. Its high backrest and adjustable lumbar support help promote a more comfortable sitting posture, while the moulded foam seat delivers balanced cushioning throughout the working day.

Built with fixed armrests, a one-angle locking mechanism and smooth height adjustment, the ALTO is a practical choice for directors’ rooms, workstations, meeting rooms and home offices. Its clean, modern design also makes it easy to match with a wide range of office interiors.

Product Features

  • High backrest provides supportive coverage for the upper, middle and lower back.
  • Adjustable lumbar support helps provide added support to the lower-back area.
  • Moulded foam seat offers comfortable cushioning for everyday use.
  • Durable seat cover provides a neat and professional finish.
  • Fixed armrests provide stable support for the arms and shoulders.
  • One-angle locking mechanism allows the chair to be secured in an upright working position.
  • Pneumatic seat-height adjustment helps users achieve a suitable seating height.
  • Reliable Class 3 gas lift provides smooth and stable height adjustment.
  • Durable G340 nylon base offers dependable stability for daily office use.
  • Equipped with five 55 mm PA castors for smooth movement around the workspace.
  • Suitable for offices, directors’ rooms, meeting rooms, study areas and home workspaces.
  • Available in multiple colour options to suit different office interiors.

Pre-Order Terms:

This item is available on a pre-order basis. Estimated waiting time is 35–50 days after order confirmation.

Minimum order quantity: 10 units
Colour option: Minimum 10 units can be ordered in any selected colour, subject to availability.

Carton size: 650 x 310 x 570 mm/per unit

desc: PRE ORDER UNIT: MINIMUM ORDER OF 10 UNITS & ABOVE! LUNAR High Back Office Chair Product Description The LUNAR High Back Office Chair is a practical and space-saving seating solution designed for modern workspaces. Its supportive high backrest and mou
descHtml:
PRE ORDER UNIT: MINIMUM ORDER OF 10 UNITS & ABOVE!

LUNAR High Back Office Chair

Product Description

The LUNAR High Back Office Chair is a practical and space-saving seating solution designed for modern workspaces. Its supportive high backrest and moulded foam seat provide enhanced everyday comfort, while the flip-up armrests allow the chair to slide easily under most desks when not in use.

Equipped with a swivel-tilt mechanism, adjustable seat height and a durable nylon base, the LUNAR is suitable for workstations, meeting rooms, training rooms and home offices. It is available in multiple colour options to complement different office interiors.

Product Features

  • High backrest provides better support for the upper, middle and lower back.
  • Contoured backrest supports a comfortable sitting posture during daily office use.
  • Moulded foam seat provides balanced cushioning and everyday comfort.
  • Durable fabric seat cover creates a clean and professional appearance.
  • Flip-up armrests can be raised to save space and allow the chair to fit under most desks.
  • Swivel-and-tilt mechanism allows smooth rotation and gentle reclining movement.
  • Pneumatic seat-height adjustment helps users achieve a suitable working height.
  • Reliable Class 3 gas lift provides smooth and stable height adjustment.
  • Durable 320 mm nylon base offers dependable stability for everyday use.
  • Equipped with five 50 mm nylon castors for smooth movement around the workspace.
  • Available in black, grey, blue and beige colour options.
  • Suitable for office workstations, meeting rooms, training rooms, study areas and home offices.

Pre-Order Terms:

This item is available on a pre-order basis. Estimated waiting time is 35–50 days after order confirmation.

Minimum order quantity: 10 units
Colour option: Minimum 10 units can be ordered in any selected colour, subject to availability.

descHtml:
PRE ORDER UNIT: MINIMUM ORDER OF 10 UNITS & ABOVE!

Product Description

The LINA High Back Mesh Office Chair combines breathable comfort with enhanced lumbar support for everyday office use. Its contoured high backrest and uplift lumbar support help maintain a more supportive sitting posture, while the moulded foam seat provides comfortable cushioning throughout the working day. With fixed connecting armrests, adjustable seat height and a one-angle locking mechanism, the LINA is suitable for workstations, meeting rooms and home offices.

Product Features

  • High backrest provides supportive coverage for the upper, middle and lower back.
  • Breathable mesh backrest improves airflow and helps reduce heat during extended sitting.
  • Uplift lumbar support provides additional support to the lower-back area.
  • Moulded foam seat offers balanced cushioning and dependable everyday comfort.
  • Durable fabric seat cover provides a clean and professional finish.
  • Fixed connecting armrests provide stable support for the arms and shoulders.
  • One-angle locking mechanism allows the chair to be secured in an upright working position.
  • Pneumatic seat-height adjustment helps users achieve a suitable desk height.
  • Reliable black gas lift provides smooth and stable height adjustment.
  • Durable 340 mm nylon base offers dependable stability for commercial use.
  • Equipped with five 55 mm nylon castors for smooth movement around the workspace.
  • Available in black and light-grey colour options to complement different office interiors.
  • Suitable for offices, workstations, meeting rooms, study areas and home workspaces.

Pre-Order Terms:

This item is available on a pre-order basis. Estimated waiting time is 35–50 days after order confirmation.

Minimum order quantity: 10 units
Colour option: Minimum 10 units can be ordered in any selected colour, subject to availability.

descHtml:
PRE ORDER UNIT: MINIMUM ORDER OF 10 UNITS & ABOVE!

LUMINA High Back Mesh Office Chair

The LUMINA High Back Mesh Office Chair combines everyday comfort, breathable support and a clean modern design. Its high mesh backrest encourages airflow during long working hours, while the cushioned foam seat provides comfortable support for daily office use. Equipped with fixed armrests, a swivel-tilt mechanism and adjustable seat height, it is a practical seating choice for workstations, meeting rooms and home offices.

Product Features

  • High backrest with breathable stretch mesh fabric for improved airflow and comfort.
  • Contoured backrest provides supportive seating for the upper and lower back.
  • Comfortable cut-foam seat with a durable fabric seat cover.
  • Fixed connecting armrests provide stable support for the arms and shoulders.
  • Swivel-and-tilt mechanism allows smooth rotation and gentle reclining movement.
  • Pneumatic height adjustment allows the seat height to be adjusted easily.
  • Reliable Class 3 gas lift provides smooth and stable height adjustment.
  • Durable 320 mm nylon base offers dependable stability for everyday use.
  • Equipped with five 50 mm nylon castors for smooth movement around the workspace.
  • Contemporary design suitable for offices, meeting rooms, study areas and home workspaces.
  • Available in multiple colour options to complement different office interiors.

desc: PRE ORDER UNIT: MINIMUM ORDER OF 10 UNITS & ABOVE! LIVI High Back Executive Office Chair Product Description The LIVI High Back Executive Office Chair is designed for enhanced ergonomic support and all-day working comfort. Its high backrest, adjustab
descHtml:
PRE ORDER UNIT: MINIMUM ORDER OF 10 UNITS & ABOVE!

LIVI High Back Executive Office Chair

Product Description

The LIVI High Back Executive Office Chair is designed for enhanced ergonomic support and all-day working comfort. Its high backrest, adjustable lumbar support and 2D headrest help support the neck, upper back and lower back during extended periods of sitting.

The chair is equipped with a wire-controlled mechanism and sliding seat function, allowing users to adjust their seating position more easily. Together with 3D adjustable armrests, a moulded foam seat and smooth-rolling PU castors, the LIVI is suitable for executive offices, management rooms and modern workstations.

Product Features

  • High backrest provides supportive coverage for the neck, upper back and lower back.
  • Adjustable 2D headrest supports different head and neck positions.
  • Adjustable lumbar support provides targeted support for the lower back.
  • Wire-controlled mechanism allows convenient chair adjustments from a seated position.
  • Sliding seat function helps users adjust the seat depth for improved thigh support.
  • 3D adjustable armrests can be repositioned to support different working postures.
  • Moulded foam seat provides supportive cushioning for extended sitting.
  • Durable fabric seat cover offers a clean and professional finish.
  • Pneumatic seat-height adjustment helps users achieve a suitable desk height.
  • Reliable black gas lift provides smooth and stable height adjustment.
  • Durable 350 mm nylon base offers dependable stability for commercial use.
  • Equipped with five 60 mm PU castors for smoother and quieter movement.
  • Suitable for executive offices, management rooms, workstations and home offices.
  • Available in multiple colour options to complement different office interiors.

Pre-Order Terms:

This item is available on a pre-order basis. Estimated waiting time is 35–50 days after order confirmation.

Minimum order quantity: 10 units
Colour option: Minimum 10 units can be ordered in any selected colour, subject to availability.

Carton size: 650 x 310 x 570 mm/per unit

descHtml:
PRE ORDER UNIT: MINIMUM ORDER OF 10 UNITS & ABOVE!

 

LUNO High Back Mesh Office Chair

Product Description

The LUNO High Back Mesh Office Chair is designed for breathable comfort, ergonomic support and flexible everyday use. Its mesh seat and high mesh backrest improve airflow, helping users remain comfortable during long working hours.

The chair features adjustable lumbar support, 3D armrests and a sliding seat function that allows users to fine-tune their seating position. Its wire-controlled mechanism places the main adjustments within easy reach, making the LUNO suitable for executive offices, management rooms, modern workstations and home offices.

Product Features

  • High mesh backrest provides breathable support for the upper, middle and lower back.
  • Mesh seat promotes better airflow and reduces heat during extended periods of sitting.
  • Adjustable lumbar support provides targeted support for the lower-back area.
  • Sliding seat function allows the seat depth to be adjusted for improved thigh support.
  • Wire-controlled mechanism enables convenient chair adjustments from a seated position.
  • 3D adjustable armrests can be repositioned to support different working postures.
  • Pneumatic seat-height adjustment helps users achieve a suitable desk height.
  • Reliable black gas lift provides smooth and stable height adjustment.
  • Durable 350 mm nylon base offers dependable stability for daily commercial use.
  • Equipped with five 60 mm PU castors for smoother and quieter movement.
  • Breathable construction makes the chair suitable for long working hours.
  • Available in black, grey and blue colour options.
  • Suitable for executive offices, management rooms, workstations and home offices.

Pre-Order Terms:

This item is available on a pre-order basis. Estimated waiting time is 35–50 days after order confirmation.

Minimum order quantity: 10 units
Colour option: Minimum 10 units can be ordered in any selected colour, subject to availability.

title: Stratus 1 High Back Office Chair
name: Stratus 1 High Back Office Chair
desc: The Stratus 1 ergonomic office chair is designed to provide superior comfort and support for long working hours. Featuring a high backrest with adjustable headrest, breathable mesh back support, and ergonomic lumbar design, this chair promotes proper
descHtml:
The Stratus 1 ergonomic office chair is designed to provide superior comfort and support for long working hours. Featuring a high backrest with adjustable headrest, breathable mesh back support, and ergonomic lumbar design, this chair promotes proper posture and reduces fatigue throughout the day.

Its arc-shaped ergonomic backrest adapts naturally to the spine while the breathable mesh fabric improves airflow, keeping users comfortable even during extended sitting sessions. The durable chair mechanism and smooth caster base ensure stability and mobility in modern office environments.

Ideal for corporate offices, workstations, home offices, and professional workspaces, the Stratus chair is a practical ergonomic seating solution for improving productivity and workplace comfort.


Suitable for:

Office workstations

Corporate offices

Home office setups

Interior design office projects


Features:

- Fixed Armrest

- Customizable colours for backrest and cushion seat

- Different colours for backrest frame
